description: Rothco’s Flyers Helmet Shoulder Bag (19” X 19”) is the ultimate travel companion for professionals needing to transport their helmet and essential gear securely. Constructed with long-lasting polyester material, this durable bag features a padded interior to ensure your helmet remains protected during travel. The spacious design of the pilot helmet bag (19” X 19”) provides ample room to store not only your helmet but also helmet attachments and other crucial items. For additional storage, the bag includes 2 outside hook & loop pockets with snap closures, perfect for quick access to smaller essentials. The adjustable and removable shoulder strap, along with 2 sturdy top carry handles, offers versatile carrying options to suit your preference. The brass zipper closure ensures your contents remain secure and easily accessible. Whether you're a professional pilot or need a reliable bag for your gear, Rothco’s Flyers Helmet Shoulder Bag combines durability, convenience, and ample storage space in one essential package.
